thread.title: Plans suggest Apple will remodel its Arden Fair store

author: Sonya Sorich
title: Plans suggest Apple will remodel its Arden Fair store
text: – Digital Editor, Sacramento Business Journal Dec 20, 2018, 2:54pm PST It appears Apple Inc. wants to remodel its store in Arden Fair. Plans have been filed with the city of Sacramento for a remodeling project at 1689 Arden Way, Suite 1280. That's the suite number of the Apple retail store in Arden Fair, according to leasing materials online. The plans list a job value of $519,515. The project will remodel the existing retail sales area, including "the replacement of existing sales area fixtures and finishes with the addition of a video wall," according to plans filed with the city. In response to an inquiry from the Business Journal, representatives of Apple (Nasdaq: AAPL) said the company hasn't made any announcements regarding the Arden Fair store. However, the addition of the video wall suggests the planned local project could be related to the "Today at Apple" programming that the technology giant has brought to its stores. The effort, which launched in May 2017 , focuses on educational sessions held at Apple stores, with topics ranging from coding sessions to music labs. It appears the Arden Fair location currently hosts "Today at Apple" events, based on its website. At an Apple event in October , Angela Ahrendts , Apple's senior vice president of retail, suggested the company would continue to roll out upgrades related to "Today at Apple" at its retail stores. She announced the addition of "60 newly designed sessions" within the initiative, including expanded offerings related to music, video and design. The programming "could be retail's greatest platform for enriching lives," Ahrendts said. In November 2013, Apple opened a redesigned, relocated store in Arden Fair that was twice the size of its previous location in the shopping center. Apple representatives would not confirm the square footage of the store in Arden Fair on Wednesday. Nathan Spradlin , senior marketing manager at the mall, said Apple's space at Arden Fair is 7,222 square feet. He confirmed Apple plans to remodel its store in the center next year, but did not have additional details about the project. Apple has one other local store, which is in the Westfield Galleria at Roseville. – Digital Editor, Sacramento Business Journal Dec 20, 2018, 2:54pm PST Related Content
